description: Woodson Bradley is more than a politician, she offers common sense solutions for ALL people in North Carolina. A domestic violence survivor, business owner, mom, wife, taking care of a blended family, and the daughter of a public school teacher and social worker. She understands REAL people of North Carolina and what they want.
